import cv2, numpy as np

# Find floor-wall horizon/boundary in obs_0001, obs_0002, obs_0003, obs_0004
for idx in [1, 2, 3, 4]:
    img = cv2.imread(f'/work/observations/obs_000{idx}.png')
    # floor color is roughly [150, 143, 128] (BGR: [128, 143, 150] or similar)
    # wall color is white [255, 255, 255]
    # let's find the transition along center column u=256
    col = img[:, 256]
    transitions = []
    for v in range(511, 0, -1):
        if np.mean(col[v]) > 240 and np.mean(col[v+1]) < 200:
            transitions.append(v)
    print(f'obs_{idx} (center col 256): transitions={transitions}')
"
